description: The only capability the WebView holds, and now the whole of what the WebView may call — the application's own commands as well as Tauri-provided ones. The application command ACL is switched on (see AGENTS.md section 5), so a command absent from this list is rejected at the IPC boundary rather than silently allowed, which is what an empty list used to mean for application commands. `allow-core-version` comes from `../permissions/autogenerated/`, generated out of the command list in `build.rs`; it is the single application command the skeleton needs. Each entry added here is a widening that AGENTS.md section 5 requires the pull request to state. `core:default` in particular is not such an entry: it is Tauri's aggregate of every core plugin default, which would grant absolute-path resolution, event listen and emit, and the whole menu and tray command set at once — and would leave `core:image`'s from_path inert only for as long as the image-png and image-ico Cargo features stay off, so that setting a PNG tray icon would turn it into an unscoped file read without this file changing.
